description: This file implements the OpenCDM (Open Content Decryption Module) interface, including session management, decryption, system support checks, and metadata retrieval for DRM systems. It contains class definitions, static singleton pattern, and functions for handling DRM sessions and keys.

classes.name: OpenCDMAccessor
classes.description: Singleton class managing DRM sessions and keys, providing methods to wait for keys, retrieve sessions, and handle system destruction.

methods.name: StringToAllocatedBuffer
methods.description: Template function converting a std::string to a buffer, handling size and null-termination, returning error codes.

methods.name: WaitForKey
methods.description: Waits for a specific key status within a timeout, returning session ID if found.

methods.name: Session
methods.description: Retrieves a session object by session ID.

methods.name: AddSession
methods.description: Adds a session to the internal map.

methods.name: RemoveSession
methods.description: Removes a session from the internal map.

methods.name: SystemBeingDestructed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a DRM system is being destructed, checking for associated sessions.
